checks.explanation: A roughly 3-month forecast (from June 2026, so targeting around September 2026) for Mythos-level offensive vulnerability-finding capability to be available in the wild via open/Chinese models; the window has not fully elapsed and no clear public confirmation exists yet either way.

An open-ended 'in our lifetime' forecast about Google becoming the first company of its scale; several companies (including SpaceX and Nvidia) are already valued near or above $1-2 trillion, so the claim likely refers to a much larger valuation milestone (consistent with the episode's '$10T' framing) that has not yet been reached and has no fixed resolution date.
A 10-year forecast (through roughly 2036) for the US to rebuild a domestic hardware/chip supply chain; far too early to assess.
